theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] {I : C} [CategoryTheory.Injective I] {L : CochainComplex C ℤ} {i : ℤ} (ι : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I ⟶ L) [L.IsStrictlyGE i] [QuasiIsoAt ι i] : CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono ι := by
  have h_is_k_injective : L.IsKInjective := CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective L i (by apply_instance)
  have h_quasi_iso_iff : QuasiIso ι ↔ HomologicalComplex.homotopyEquivalences C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ι :=
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective.quasiIso_iff h_is_k_injective (by apply_instance) (by apply_instance)
  have h_quasi : QuasiIso ι := (iff.mp h_quasi_iso_iff) $ by apply_instance
  exact CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono.of_quasi_iso_and_mono h_quasi (by apply_instance)
